summary: MINISO Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a series of Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns covering share repurchases from September 22-28, 2026. The filings disclose buybacks executed on-market, with one tranche showing 108,764 ordinary shares repurchased for cancellation at USD 2.2668 per share, equal to roughly 0.009% of issued shares. Issued shares stood near 1,214,041,449. Repurchased shares are held pending cancellation. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock is cited. Watch for continued daily buyback disclosures, aggregate capital returned, and any acceleration signaling management's valuation view.
